title: Hⁿ of an offset parallel n-plane inside a ball centred at 0
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be a linear subspace with dim V = n (Module.finrank ℝ V = n), let w ∈ V^⊥ and R ∈ ℝ with ‖w‖ < R. Then Hⁿ({y ∈ ℝ^P : y − w ∈ V} ∩ B_R(0)) = ω_n·ofReal((√(R² − ‖w‖²))ⁿ), where Hⁿ = μHE[n] is Mathlib's Euclidean-normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P = Euclid P, B_R(0) is the open ball, ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball of ℝⁿ, and √ = Real.sqrt.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (w : Euclid P) (R : ℝ), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → w ∈ Vᗮ → ‖w‖ < R → μHE[n] ({y : Euclid P | y - w ∈ V} ∩ ball 0 R) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (R ^ 2 - ‖w‖ ^ 2) ^ n)
